decisions.reason: The Trivital supplement range builds on the firm's established pharmacy channel and costs little to keep listed, so the option stays open while its demand is still uncertain.

The skin and hair supplement had its own page through 2019 and needs little capital to keep, so it is retained as a cheap option within the range, though it is more exposed to crowded-market pressure.
Joint health is a steady pharmacy category that fits the firm's consumer health strategy, and the low holding cost justifies keeping the product while results accumulate.
The immune supplement was the newest addition to the range and immune products gained demand after 2020, so its upside remains plausible and it should be kept.

The 2018 valsartan problem notice hurt this generic far from the core business, but the active ingredient remains widely prescribed and the firm's quality capabilities allow it to keep supplying, so it is kept for now with an elevated risk of being dropped.
An over-the-counter triptan is a differentiated, defensible product that matches the firm's push into consumer health, and its value is still unfolding, so it is kept.
